scope: Exactly partitions.iconography in frozen counterpart protocol; every displayed other text line represented separately.

method.primary: Visual examination of complete Texts entries on PDF147–156 and168 and numbered primary sign inventory; full-row images retain reference and metadata.
method.candidate_use: Glossa export was consulted for proposed first-line sign IDs in a subset; accepted signs were visually checked against primary entry and numbered primary inventory. This was not a blinded transcription. No candidate-export fallback was admitted.
method.normalization: Printed RTL-normalized sequence, separate side and line identifiers; actual object reading direction is not inferred from normalization.
method.LOSS: Primary hatching records an unknown positive-length missing span; never expanded to one presumed sign.
method.UNKNOWN: Reserved for visible but reviewer-unidentified glyph; none remain in this partition.
method.doubt: A primary doubt dot is encoded as *Mddd, not silently removed.
method.symbol_only: Metadata line9 entries have no printed script string and are preserved separately. Text-bearing rows that also carry symbol codes remain text rows.
method.exclusion: Every selected exact stroke-plus-U field excluded, including both fields of5413; no other text concatenation.

limitations: These are primary editorial sign drawings, not independent artifact photographs.
